question: In October 2020, ______ Indian beaches were awarded the ‘Blue Flag’ certification by an international jury comprising of eminent members such as UNEP, UNWTO, FEE and IUCN.
solution:
The correct answer is **__8.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Eight Indian beaches have been awarded the prestigious 'Blue Flag' certification by an international jury comprising members of the following organizations:
 
 
• The International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN).
 
• World Tourism Organization (UNWTO).
 
• United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP).
 
• Foundation for Environmental Education (FEE).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **The 'Blue Flag' certification**:

 
 
• It is a certification that is given to a** beach, marina, or sustainable boating tourism operator**.
 
• It also serves as an **eco-label**.
 
• The certification** indicates their high environmental and quality standards**.
 
• It is **awarded by the Foundation for Environmental Education, an NGO based in Denmark**.
 
• It puts strict environmental, educational, safety-related & access-related parameters that applicants must achieve and maintain.
 
• It was** instituted in France in 1985 and for nations out of Europe in 2001**.
 
• It is **awarded annually to beaches of FEE member countries**.
 
• **Forty-seven countries currently participate in this program. 4,671 beaches, marinas, and boats have this certification (as of January 2021).**
 
• It promotes sustainable development in freshwater & marine areas.
 
 
 
• **Criteria to get Blue Flag Certification**:
 
 
• It has** four main criteria** which are the following:
 
• Water quality.
 
• Environmental management.
 
• Environmental education.
 
• Safety.
 
• Countries with the highest number of** Blue Flag Beaches:**
 
• **Spain: 578, the highest number of Blue Flag beaches.**
 
• **Turkey: 436.**
 
• **Greece: 395.**
 
• **France: 394.**
 
• **Italy: 342.​**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Foundation for Environmental Education**:

 
 
• It is a non-profit organisation that promotes sustainable development through environmental education.
 
• It runs five programmes to fulfil its objective: Blue Flag. Eco-Schools. Young Reporters for the Environment.Learning about Forests Green Key.
 
• Headquarters: Copenhagen, Denmark.
 
• Founded: 1981.
 
• Main organ: General Assembly.
 
 
 
• **IUCN**:
 
 
• It is an international organization working in the field of nature conservation and sustainable use of natural resources.
 
• Headquarters: Gland, Switzerland.
 
• Founder: Julian Huxley.
 
• Founded: 1948.
 
 
 
• **World Tourism Organization**:
 
 
• It is a special agency of the United Nations.
 
• It is delegated to promote responsible, sustainable and universally accessible tourism.
 
• Headquarters: Madrid, Spain.
 
• Founded: 1975.
 
• Parent organization: United Nations.
 
• Member States: 159.
 
• **India joined in 1975.**
 
 
 
• **The United Nations Environment Programme**:
 
 
• It is responsible for managing environmental issues within the United Nations members.
 
• Headquarters: Nairobi, Kenya.
 
• Founder: Maurice Strong.
 
• Founded: 1972
 
• Member States: 193.
